correctness.rationale: The exact last-digit decomposition (including n=0) produces a four-state parity DFA. Its nonabsorbing matrix entries are checked by the explicit three digit-type images; x_L-z_L=1 follows from the transition equations, and A_L=x_L+y_L leads to A_L=(b-1)A_(L-1)+2A_(L-2)-1. Solving gives the GF and roots. At b>=3, 2<lambda+<b, lambda+lambda-=-2 and positive leading coefficient imply theta in (0,1) and Theta(X^theta) by monotonic blocks. At b=2 an independent mod-3 parity induction yields density 2/3. Exact polynomial GF2 computations confirm 63 blocks; independent pointwise checks confirm 35,258 coefficients. All quantifiers and normalization are explicit.

value.rationale: Odd representational multiplicity is a natural arithmetic statistic for restricted powers-of-base partitions. The three-state quotient has a nontrivial invariant, giving a base-uniform exact census and exponent with a sharp binary/nonbinary density boundary; none follows merely from a finite OEIS match. This supplies a reusable spectral description of an infinite family, beyond a narrow table or routine arithmetic substitution.
